subject: openCR with animals added and removed for management

messages.author: 91bd4367f6044e8d
messages.subject: openCR with animals added and removed for management
parts:
Hi there,

I'm wanting to run some open pop models but my population has animals added and removed by managers. I was just wondering if there's a way to add this information in the capthist or elsewhere so I have accurate recruitment and survival estimates?

Thanks,

Rebecca

messages.author: 500d98abd0834d18
messages.subject: Re: openCR with animals added and removed for management
parts:
Hi,
When you build a multisession capthist object when every single primary occasion has its own animal set, adding and removing would be then considered as demographic parameters.
I would add such information as a covariate within your dataset, in a new column where you distinguish between wild and "menaged". Maybe it works.

Stefano

messages.author: 118cea91a1619106
messages.subject: Re: openCR with animals added and removed for management
parts:
Removal-on-capture is handled by coding the capture occasion as negative (see secr-datainput.pdf). Survival analysis should be just fine; recruitment I'm not sure.
Other removals (outside the usual capture process) and known additions are not specifically allowed at present. They would be easy to code, but motivation has been lacking.
Murray

messages.author: 118cea91a1619106
messages.subject: Re: openCR with animals added and removed for management
parts:
Non-spatial additions are straightforward, and covered by Shirley P in her 2010 Biometrics paper (66:883-890) as "unnatural arrivals" (p 884). I can program that once I decide on a clean way to specify the additions. I haven't thought through whether it gets more complicated when animals are localised in space. Perhaps it's OK if you're willing to treat them as located at random across the habitat mask irrespective of the release point.
Murray
